show: My Favorite Murder with Karen Kilgariff and Georgia Hardstark

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: Two true crime cases and the bizarre 1973 Acolli Expedition sex raft experiment.
kurzfassung: The hosts cover two distinct historical stories involving isolation and conflict. First, they detail how two Atlanta detectives quickly linked and solved a string of murders in the 1980s. Second, they examine the Acolli Expedition, a 1973 scientific raft journey designed to study human aggression that ultimately proved the power of cooperation.
stichpunkte: Atlanta homicide detectives Sheila Cumberworth and Marcellus Head investigated a series of murders targeting young black male sex workers in the mid-1980s.
The detectives realized multiple cases shared identical MOs, locations, and ballistic evidence, eventually leading them to serial killer Michael Terry.
Michael Terry was arrested in November 1986, confessed to six murders, and received multiple life sentences.
In 1973, Mexican anthropologist Santiago Genevez organized the Acolli Expedition, placing ten diverse volunteers on a small raft to sail across the Atlantic.
Genevez hypothesized that close quarters and isolation would trigger sexual tension, friction, and violent behavior among the participants.
Despite Genevez actively trying to provoke drama and stir up conflict, the crew formed a tight-knit, peaceful community and successfully navigated multiple near-disasters together.
Modern observers and participants noted that Genevez's heavy-handed methods failed because the participants chose cooperation and mutual understanding over violence.

kapitel.titel: The Acolli Expedition Sex Raft Experiment

clips.text: Reflecting on the false sense of accomplishment felt during early adulthood.
Discussing a well-known Atlanta grocery store infamous for violent crimes and its resulting unofficial merchandise.
Mentioning the overwhelming volume of listener messages regarding the notorious supermarket compared to a single email about another topic.

clips.hook: A dangerous voyage across the open ocean
clips.text: Planning a brief initial test trip to see if a maritime route is viable before committing further.
Recounting a grueling 101-day ocean voyage that ended on August 21, 1973.
